items.title: Epoch AI data centers (global) — 2026-10-29
items.summary: Epoch AI covers 96 large AI data centers (75 drawing power now): 14.5 GW current power, 15.2M H100-equivalents, 10 countries with capacity. By power: United States 12.21 GW (84%), Malaysia 1.25 GW (9%), China 0.73 GW (5%), United Kingdom 0.09 GW (1%). Indiana: 3 sites, 1.22 GW = 8.4% of the covered global total (Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle (1037 MW), Meta Jeffersonville (178 MW), Google Fort Wayne (0 MW)). Covered set only, not world capacity; skewed to the US. Dataset updated 2026-10-28.
